asset_type: 48-cell original animation atlas per current Godot player
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept game animation atlas. Asset type: production sprite sheet for an existing Godot 2.5D RPG, not a concept image. Reference image is the exact existing hero identity, face, clothing, palette and proportions to preserve. Create exactly 48 separate full-body animation frames on a genuinely transparent background, precisely 8 columns by 6 rows of equally sized cells, no visible grid, no labels, no text. Square canvas. Every cell must contain exactly one complete hero, separated by generous transparent gutters. Crisp hand-painted pixel-art edges matching the reference, detailed readable RPG sprite shading, neutral lighting. No scenery, no floor, no cast shadow disks, no particle effects outside cells. Maintain stable size and fixed feet baseline at 91% of each cell height; standing hero body about 72% of the cell height, ample headroom for a torch. Add a believable small leather adventuring backpack consistent with their costume. Weapons and shield remain sheathed/slung for these two-hand backpack interactions. Row 1, columns 1–8: continuous eight-frame sequence, facing three-quarter southeast, take backpack off, place it beside feet, open flap, reach inside, withdraw a small travel item, close flap, shoulder bag, return upright holding item. Row 2 columns 1–8: inverse action, store the held small item, close flap, shoulder bag, return to upright empty hand; distinct drawn poses, not duplicate frames. Rows 3–6: walking holding a lit wooden torch steadily in the right hand, left hand naturally counter-swinging; each direction has four true walking-cycle poses (contact, down, passing, up), stable flame and anatomy. Row 3 columns 1–4 NORTH/back view, columns 5–8 NORTHEAST. Row 4 columns 1–4 EAST profile, columns 5–8 SOUTHEAST. Row 5 columns 1–4 SOUTH/front view, columns 5–8 SOUTHWEST. Row 6 columns 1–4 WEST profile, columns 5–8 NORTHWEST. All walking poses hold the torch aloft clearly, no bag-handling while walking. Preserve character identity in rear and side views. No new clothes, no portrait substitutions, no large glowing halos. This is a single uniform atlas that will be sliced into 48 cells.

acceptance: Candidate; inspect in-engine, user artistic approval and physical-device acceptance remain separate.
import_note: Measured alpha bands on 1254x1254 originals; row boundaries are not uniform. Horizontal edges use full image width / 8, alpha cutoff 32, source files preserved. Height normalized to first standing pose.
